newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Labroy Marine offers 52 mln shares at S$0.69 each.
newsitem.headline: Labroy Marine offers 52 mln shares at S$0.69 each.

text.p: Singapore's marine-based Labroy Marine Ltd said on Wednesday it was offering 52 million shares at Singapore $0.69 each in its initial public offer.
The company said in a statement 10.4 million shares would be placed out to institutional investors and the balance would be offered to the public, staff and business associates.
The offer comprises 30.0 million new shares and 22.0 million vendor shares. The shares are priced at a 1996 forecast price earnings ratio of 11.4 times.

Labroy aims to raise net proceeds of about S$19.65 million to be used for construction and conversion of vessels, expansion of its shipyard facilities in Batam, building of a floating dock and repayment of bank borrowings and working capital.
The IPO closes on Oct 16 and trading starts on Oct 18.
